import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Node {
        int r, c, dis;
        Node(int r, int c, int dis) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
            this.dis = dis;
        }
    }

    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    
    static Queue<Node> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static char[] buf = new char[15];
    static int nodeCount, n1, m, lim, totalFlow;
    static int[] pred = new int[202];
    static int[] height = new int[202];
    static int[] gap = new int[203];
    static int[][] adjCap = new int[202][202];
    static int[][] flow = new int[202][202];
    static int[] path = new int[202];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[12][12];
    static boolean[][] baseGrid = new boolean[12][12];
    static boolean foundPath;
    
    // Additional arrays for a and b mapping
    static int[][] a = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] b = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] d0 = new int[12][12];

    static void dfsSearch(int u, int bottleneck) {
        if (u == nodeCount + 1) {
            pred[0] = bottleneck;
            foundPath = true;
            return;
        }
        int minH = nodeCount + 2;
        for (int v = 0; v <= nodeCount + 1; ++v) {
            if (flow[u][v] < adjCap[u][v]) {
                minH = Math.min(minH, height[v]);
                if (height[u] == height[v] + 1) {
                    path[++totalFlow] = v;
                    dfsSearch(v, Math.min(bottleneck, adjCap[u][v] - flow[u][v]));
                    if (!visited[0][0] || foundPath) return;
                    path[totalFlow--] = 0;
                }
            }
            if (flow[v][u] > 0) {
                minH = Math.min(minH, height[v]);
                if (height[u] == height[v] + 1) {
                    path[++totalFlow] = -v;
                    dfsSearch(v, Math.min(bottleneck, flow[v][u]));
                    if (!visited[0][0] || foundPath) return;
                    path[totalFlow--] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        if (minH + 1 != height[u]) {
            --gap[height[u]];
            if (gap[height[u]] == 0) visited[0][0] = false;
            height[u] = minH + 1;
            ++gap[height[u]];
        }
    }

    static boolean canAugment() {
        foundPath = false;
        pred[0] = n1;
        totalFlow = 0;
        path[0] = 0;
        dfsSearch(0, n1);
        return foundPath;
    }

    static void augment() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= totalFlow; ++i) {
            if (path[i] > 0) {
                flow[Math.abs(path[i - 1])][path[i]] += pred[0];
            } else {
                flow[-path[i]][Math.abs(path[i - 1])] -= pred[0];
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        m = sc.nextInt();
        lim = sc.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                buf[j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (buf[j] == 'Z') {
                    Node start = new Node(i, j, 0);
                    q.add(start);
                } else if (buf[j] != 'Y') {
                    visited[i][j] = true;
                    baseGrid[i][j] = true;
                    d0[i][j] = lim;
                    int val = buf[j] - '0';
                    if (val > 0) {
                        a[i][j] = ++nodeCount;
                        adjCap[0][nodeCount] = val;
                        n1 += val;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.arraycopy(visited, 0, baseGrid, 0, visited.length);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                buf[j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (buf[j] == 'Z' || buf[j] == 'Y') continue;
                int val = buf[j] - '0';
                if (val > 0) {
                    b[i][j] = ++nodeCount;
                    adjCap[nodeCount][m * m + 1] = val;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (nodeCount != m * m) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i)
                for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j)
                    if (b[i][j] > 0) {
                        int idx = b[i][j];
                        adjCap[idx][nodeCount + 1] = adjCap[idx][m * m + 1];
                        adjCap[idx][m * m + 1] = 0;
                    }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Node cur = q.poll();
            int r = cur.r, c = cur.c;
            d0[r][c] = cur.dis;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dx[k], nc = c + dy[k];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < 12 && nc >= 0 && nc < 12 && visited[nr][nc]) {
                    Node next = new Node(nr, nc, cur.dis + 1);
                    q.add(next);
                    visited[nr][nc] = false;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                if (a[i][j] == 0) continue;
                System.arraycopy(baseGrid, 0, visited, 0, visited.length);
                visited[i][j] = false;
                Node start = new Node(i, j, 0);
                q.add(start);
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    Node cur = q.poll();
                    int r = cur.r, c = cur.c;
                    if (b[r][c] > 0 && cur.dis <= d0[r][c]) {
                        adjCap[a[i][j]][b[r][c]] = n1;
                    }
                    if (cur.dis + 1 > lim || cur.dis >= d0[r][c]) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int nr = r + dx[k], nc = c + dy[k];
                        if (nr >= 0 && nr < 12 && nc >= 0 && nc < 12 && visited[nr][nc]) {
                            Node next = new Node(nr, nc, cur.dis + 1);
                            q.add(next);
                            visited[nr][nc] = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        gap[0] = nodeCount + 2;
        visited[0][0] = true;
        while (visited[0][0] && height[0] <= nodeCount + 2) {
            while (canAugment()) {
                augment();
            }
        }
        
        int result = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= nodeCount; ++i) {
            result += flow[i][nodeCount + 1];
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
